tagline: The app that puts the desktop on your screen
description:
**Xios** is the one app iOS sees. It appears on the Home Screen as **X11**, owns a Metal layer and the UIKit input surface, and renders nothing of its own: the compositor hands it an output IOSurface over a mach port, the app draws that as a Metal texture every frame, and your touches and keystrokes go back to the compositor. Nothing is streamed and nothing is copied.

It opens to a **launcher**: a card for every desktop that is running (KDE, GNOME, the iosc shell), each with a thumbnail, its state and its size. Tap a card to go full screen into it, touch and hold for Stop, Open app in it or Change size, and use **New Desktop** to start another; it offers the flavors you have installed and names the package for the rest. Desktops run side by side; the app only draws the one in front of you.

The fullscreen flavors need it, so you normally do not install it directly: **xios-gnome**, **xios-kde**, and **xios-x11** pull it in through **xios-core**. The per-app **xios-native** flavor doesn't use it.

You can also start a desktop from the shell with `xios-session gnome` (or `kde`, `iosc`). Inside a desktop there is nothing but the desktop:

- **three-finger tap**, or a pull down from the top edge, opens the switcher (Home, other desktops, Apps, Keyboard pad, Stop)
- **touch and hold** or a **two-finger tap** is a right click
- **pinch** zooms, **two-finger drag** scrolls
- **swipe up from the lower edge** raises the iOS keyboard

The app is unsigned, so it needs **AppSync Unified** (from the https://cydia.akemi.ai/ repo) to launch. Rootless jailbreaks only (/var/jb), iOS/iPadOS 16 or newer, iPad.

changelog.notes:
- Asks ioscd which desktops are installed, so New Desktop matches exactly what xios-session can start
- Falls back to checking the files itself when ioscd is older than 0.1.14

- Rewritten: the app opens to a launcher of desktop cards with thumbnails, and each desktop has its own connection
- Several desktops can run at once; switching detaches the one you leave
- Rotation reconnects at once instead of flashing black; a second finger no longer breaks a drag
- New Desktop offers only the flavors you have installed and names the package for the others
- When the session launcher refuses to start a desktop, it says why in its own words
- Change size works on a desktop in its own slot
- Long-press is always right click; the status file and every diagnostic write moved off the main thread
- Needs xios-session 1.0.81 and iosc 0.9.49 for side-by-side desktops
- Ships together with xios-launcher-tools 0.1.12: the picker and ioscd now agree on desktop-file ids
- Lets go of a display once its compositor is gone, so taps reach the desktop that is actually running instead of a stopped one

- Fixes a trackpad click that stayed held down, which made everything drag-select
- With a mouse or trackpad attached, the iPadOS pointer takes the desktop's cursor shape

- First packaged release: the display app now installs from the repo instead of being sideloaded
- Zero-copy IOSurface presentation through Metal, session and dimension picker, multi-display switching
- Touch, Pencil, hardware keyboard, and on-screen keyboard routed back to the display server
